rationale: Original active portal refresh depended on startup/pageshow/visibility transitions and could retain revoked records indefinitely in ready state. This violates bounded revocation visibility and does not communicate stale retrieval time continuously. Current inspected repair adds one61second visible-only batched refresh timer, clears it on pagehide/restarts on pageshow, and displays fetchedAt in the condition line. Failed fetch retains dated stale state. Controlled timer and revision/failure browser checks remain required.
